questions: Verify print mode, no-session-persistence, structured schema, tool restrictions and resume flags.
Measure subscription quota separately from API cash and cache write/read economics.
decision: Keep the Claude CLI adapter thin and version-qualified, with explicit session, schema, permission and usage contracts.
code_observations: build_worker_command uses Claude print mode with disabled session persistence; a subsequent fresh process cannot be assumed to remember the previous attempt.
The runner has separate worker and summary command builders. A read-only summary must remain a restricted command path rather than a general implementation worker with a polite prompt.

symbols.name: ## Elevation mechanics (how a route is actually obtained)

implementation_steps: Add recorded help/version fixtures and a capability map for the exact installed Claude CLI. Probe flags non-generatively and fail visibly on unsupported combinations.
Preserve fresh-context defaults. Separate optional resume/session-retention experiments from normal execution and document that conversation persistence does not snapshot source files.
Test structured report extraction, schema rejection, malformed envelopes and nonzero statuses separately. A valid JSON shape cannot replace deterministic product validation.
Qualify read-only paths with an actual tool allowlist/sandbox boundary and clean environment, including third-party endpoint profiles.
Capture available usage fields in native units, retaining null for absent values. Do not equate subscription tokens with API invoices or assume a universal cache rate.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Default worker argv retains no-session-persistence and existing approved permission behavior.
Summary mode cannot write a planted repository file or execute an unapproved mutating tool in a supported test environment.
Invalid JSON, missing report fields, quota errors and semantic failures take different paths.
A model alias mapped through another endpoint is reported with host and backend identity.
Unknown usage is null and no secret environment values enter diagnostics.

alternatives.title: Small versioned contract fixtures and restrictive summary path
alternatives.tradeoff: Predictable upgrades without rewriting the harness in an SDK.

alternatives.tradeoff: Adds a new dependency/runtime surface without a demonstrated requirement; sessions can be evaluated later.

cost_model: Avoid an extra model call for ordinary post-failure summaries. CLI contract tests should use fake processes; authenticated smoke tests require explicit permission and report real cost separately.
